prerequisites: Students in the third phase of the study program (first semester) and students in the second phase of the study program (second semester)
A motivation letter indicating what you hope to achieve by participating in this project, due by February 20th.
A subsequent interview explaining the student's motivation.

learning_outcomes.text: You guide first-year students in independently processing complex learning content through targeted questions and feedback.
You formulate a substantiated reflection on your learning and coaching style based on concrete experiences.
You explain inclusive and sustainable learning strategies using concrete examples.
You provide constructive feedback to peers based on observations and agreements, and apply received feedback to your own actions.

syllabus_topics: Taking on the role of peer tutor for first-year students in theoretically challenging subjects.
Guiding students in small groups through their learning process.
How to deal with ethical issues (based on a recorded lesson from the course "Sustainable Entrepreneurship").
teaching_methods: Supporting the study coach in planning market
Watching a recorded lesson on "Sustainable entrepreneurship" about handling ethical issues

assessment_methods.method: Final assignment: written report and presentation justifying the student's guidance approach

assessment_rules: The overall assessment is 'Geslaagd / Niet geslaagd' (Pass / Fail). The guidance report accounts for 30% of the grade, reflection reports and logbooks for 40%, and the final assignment (written report and presentation) for 30%. There is no second examination opportunity and no partial transfers for this course.
